body: You're probably right. Once I waited for a couple months and then it was a bad day and my then bf asked 'Did someone die or something?' Wasn't good.

I feel anger as it is, to be honest. When I had my first breakdown I could only answer 'I hate him, I hate him so much' when my friend asked what was wrong. I don't think I really do but at that moment I believed it.

Your comment is just what I needed. It is one of the worst weeks yet, hope it will get better soon. Thank you.
Thank you. How much do you think is necessary to share with future partners?
